title: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.17584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operational mobile networks are rich in observations but poor in interventions: they continuously generate large volumes of passive telemetry, while controlled action--response trajectories remain comparatively scarce and costly to collect. This observation--intervention asymmetry is a central obstacle to building practical world models for RAN control. We address this problem with RAN-JEPA, an action-conditioned world model that separates representation learning from intervention learning. The model first learns a predictive latent representation from observation-only network data, adapts that representation to the target deployment domain, and then learns action-conditioned latent dynamics from controlled sleep/wake trajectories while keeping the encoder fixed. translated_title: RAN-JEPA：一种面向节能移动网络控制的动作条件世界模型
translated_abstract: 运营中的移动网络观测数据丰富但干预数据匮乏：它们持续产生大量被动遥测数据，而受控的动作-响应轨迹却相对稀少且采集成本高昂。这种观测-干预不对称性是构建实用的无线接入网（RAN）控制世界模型的主要障碍。我们通过RAN-JEPA来解决这一问题，这是一种将表征学习与干预学习相分离的动作条件世界模型。该模型首先从仅含观测数据的网络数据中学习预测性潜在表征，将该表征适配到目标部署域，然后从受控的休眠/唤醒轨迹中学习动作条件下的潜在动力学，同时保持编码器固定。我们使用公开的运营商性能数据进行预训练，并使用真实设备的四小区5G测试床进行域适配、后训练和控制评估。
tldr: 提出RAN-JEPA，一种将表征学习与干预学习分离的动作条件世界模型，先从纯观测网络数据学习潜在表征，再利用受控的休眠/唤醒轨迹学习动作条件动力学，以解决移动网络中观测数据丰富而干预数据稀缺的不对称问题，实现节能网络控制。
en_tdlr: RAN-JEPA is an action-conditioned world model that separates representation learning from intervention learning, first learning predictive latent representations from observation-only network data and then learning action-conditioned dynamics from controlled sleep/wake trajectories, addressing the observation-intervention asymmetry for energy-efficient mobile network control.
